profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap node in Riverside County, California, is tagged telecom=data_center under the name "IT," a bare two-letter label that reads as an abbreviation for information technology rather than a distinctive company or product name. Genuine data center operators in California nearly always brand their facilities with a company name, colocation product line, or campus identifier, so a label this generic is much more consistent with a placeholder tag, a mapping shorthand for an IT closet or server room inside a larger building, or an incomplete edit than with a standalone, named commercial data center. Public location records place the coordinates tied to this entry near Riverwalk Parkway, an office and light industrial corridor in Riverside County with a mix of business park tenants, and no business at that address carries the name "IT" or anything resembling it in available public directories. No operator website, business registration, trade press coverage, or permit record could be tied to this tag. Given the combination of a non distinctive name and the absence of any corroborating public record, this entry is best read as an unresolved or likely mistagged point in OpenStreetMap rather than a documented data center. Readers should treat the data center classification here as unconfirmed until a public identity for the underlying business, if any exists, surfaces.
